scope: Six new static machine concept render families

static_requirements.requirement: All six source producer IDs mapped to one selected machine design each.
Actual selected sheets inspected in full; front, rear, both sides and useful obliques visible with matching orientation labels.
Machine geometry, port side, handle, chute, vessel and support count remain coherent across views.
Blue/orange, rounded stylized forms, warm timber/metal and snow treatment match relevant approved Havenline references.
Inputs and outputs have the selected resource identities; different liquids/components remain distinguishable.
Manual worker access and typed conveyor attachment intent are visible and physically plausible.
Coal smelter is distinguishable from central hearth and steel forge; no disguised duplicate family.
Hand metal bench and assembly bench keep their two selectable recipes without adding required buildings or materials.
Oil pump is manually driven and outdoors; refinery has separate crude/coal input and fuel output.
At least one useful port/tool closeup or readable full-resolution detail per machine; no obscured essential interfaces.
Independent critic evidence is bound to exact selected files, includes per-dimension scores, and all mandatory checks pass.
All originals/rejects/prompts/reference bindings retained; static review does not claim runtime or motion approval.

future_implementation_checks: Complete idle/start/work/output-full/jammed/damaged/repair or replacement transitions in real playback
No clipping at hands, tools, belts or resource transfer points
Every recipe consumes inputs and produces outputs exactly once across save/interruption
Resource source renewal and walkable fuel-free bootstrap in actual World1
Camp placement preserves initial scale, centered furnace and both usable gates
Relevant native device performance and accessibility evidence
current_final_policy: Per applicable reference dimension >=9.9 unrounded, stronger exact10 retained, all mandatory checks passed; absent evidence blocks approval.
review_scope: Static illustrated concept sheets and exact-file PDF/PNG export; no native model, animation or runtime implementation approval.

delivery_requirements.requirement: Nine resource sheets and six machine sheets retained as exact independently approved bytes.
All18 PDF pages rendered and independently inspected;15 ZIP images and15 embedded PDF images match originals.
